extensionName.description: Proposed distinct name for this fork; not an AMO approval.

extensionDescription.message: Remember a username for a website in a Firefox container and fill it on future visits.

inputUsernameNotice.message: Enter a username in the webpage first. You can then add a rule here.
inputUsernameNotice.description: Shown when no non-empty username is available.

noPageContextNotice.message: No supported login form is available in this tab. Open an HTTP or HTTPS page in a Firefox container and try again.
noPageContextNotice.description: Shown when active-tab or container context is unavailable.

addRuleNotice.description: Prompt to add a rule. Placeholders in braces must not be localized.

updateRuleConfirm.description: Button to update an existing rule.

addedRuleNotice.message: Rule saved. Next time, {username} will be filled for {host} in {container}.

emptyRuleList.message: To create a rule, open a login page in a Firefox container, enter a username, and click the extension icon in the address bar.
emptyRuleList.description: Help text when no rules exist.
